a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: the only case where money for a UAP programme has been traced from a classified appropriation to a named contract
edges.note: Roughly $22 million was placed in the classified defense appropriation at the direction of Senate leadership and spent through DIA solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 and the resulting prime contract. AAWSAP is therefore the domain's proof of concept: it establishes that money for exactly this subject can and did move through the classified channel, and that it becomes visible only when a contract number surfaces.
